text: At its virtual public meeting held on March 31, 2022, the Toronto Police Services Board (Board) was in receipt of a report from Chief James Ramer with regard to the Toronto Police Service Response to the City Council Motion EX26.15. The Board approved the Chief’s report and agreed that a copy be forwarded to the City of Toronto Executive Committee. A copy of Board Minute P2022 – 0331-8.0 regarding this matter is attached.
The Executive Committee received Item EX33.12 for information.
